messages:
miles: Quick sync — planning to cut v1.8.0 tomorrow 09:30 PT. Console docs, SDK regen, and the docs site preview need to be merged into release/v1.8 by 18:00 PT today so I can trigger the preview deploy.

tara: Copy. Where should the SDK artifacts land? docs/generated or docs/sdk?

miles: Put generated SDK files under docs/generated. We have a post-merge task that validates and moves things if needed.

caroline: I'll own the console docs + config bump. Will keep the new FF off for canary and add rollout notes.

tara: Running the regen now (swagger -> markdown). Command:
```
./tools/regenerate_docs.sh --schema api/openapi.yaml --out docs/generated/sdk
```
ETA ~30m.

ci-bot: CI triggered for PR #1302 (sdk-docs-regen). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/1302

miles: Changelog reminder: #512 (console copy) and #517 (auth header) need to be frozen by cutoff. Please finalize text now.

caroline: #512 updated in the branch — shortened copy and clarified the step order. Marked ready.

tara: #517 finalized and added sample snippet to the changelog entry.

miles: Version bump steps (on release/v1.8):
```
git checkout release/v1.8
git pull origin release/v1.8
./scripts/bump_version.sh 1.8.0
git commit -am "chore: bump release to 1.8.0"
git push origin release/v1.8
```
(Do it after both PRs are green and merged.)

tara: PR opened -> https://git.redwood/infra/sdk-docs/pull/1302 (regen + examples). Tagging @caroline @miles for review.

ci-bot: Docs build passed for PR #1302. Artifacts uploaded.

miles: Once both PRs are merged I will run a preview deploy and post the URL. Please smoke-check: homepage examples, mobile snippet rendering, changelog page, and search index.

caroline: I'll add rollout notes to the console PR: canary = internal + 8% us-west, FF default = off. Also including rollback commands (flip FF, revert config commit).

tara: I'll test mobile rendering once preview is up.

deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued by miles — branch=release/v1.8 env=preview

deploy-bot: Preview live — https://docs.redwood.example/preview/v1.8 (build v1.8.0-preview)

tara: Preview live. Mobile snippet check: examples render, copy buttons work, no truncation on iOS Safari.

caroline: Console docs look correct on preview; added canary notes in PR description.

miles: Quick extras: after production deploy run the search index job:
```
./scripts/rebuild_search_index.sh --env production --wait
```
We had timing issues last release so please wait for completion.

ci-bot: All PRs merged into release/v1.8. Artifacts recorded.

deploy-bot: Production docs deploy started by miles — env=production version=v1.8.0 url=https://docs.redwood.example/v1.8

caroline: Doing canary roll now. FF is off. Rolling to internal cohort + 8% us-west. Monitoring for errors.

tara: Smoke verified on production: homepage, changelog, and SDK pages look correct. No console errors spotted.

miles: Final policy: any post-cutoff hotfix must be approved by both @miles and @caroline and cherry-picked into release/v1.8.

caroline: I'll attach a short rollback snippet in the PR (how to flip FF off and revert console-config).

miles: Thanks team — I'll monitor canary metrics for 12 hours and then expand rollout if stable.

participants-bot: participants updated: miles, tara, caroline, ci-bot, deploy-bot
